title.en_GB: Collaborative Research Centre 1128, sub-project MGK: Integrated Research Training Group (geo-Q Research School)
title.de_DE: Sonderforschungsbereich 1128, Teilprojekt MGK: Integriertes Graduiertenkolleg (geo-Q Research School)

value.en_GB: The focus of the integrated research training group is to provide a comprehensive education for doctoral researchers and postdocs from a wide range of fields including geodesy, physics, and space engineering, i.e. it focusses equally on doctoral researchers, early postdocs and young PIs. The curriculum consists of several lecture weeks per year. Special programmes are also offered for BSc and MSc students.
